question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Fertile watery place in a desert
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Oasis"** means a fertile spot in a desert where water is found. (मरुस्थल में उपजाऊ जलयुक्त स्थान)

 
 
• **Example: **Travelers were relieved to find an** oasis** after days of trekking through the barren desert.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Oasis**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obsolete **(प्रचलन से बाहर): No longer in use or no longer useful.

 
 
• **Example:** The typewriter has become obsolete with the advent of computers.
 
 
 
• **Obscure **(अस्पष्ट): Not well-known or not easily understood.
 
 
• **Example: **The meaning of his message was obscure and hard to grasp.
 
 
 
• **Ode** (गान): A lyric poem in the form of an address to a particular subject, often elevated in style or manner.
 
 
• **Example:** He wrote an ode to the beauty of nature.
